info.name: Veritas NetBackup REST Clients Policies API

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Maximum number of policies to return

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: Number of policies to skip for pagination

params.name: filter
params.description: OData-style filter expression. Supported fields include policyName and policyType. Example: policyName eq 'my-policy'

items.docs: Returns a list of NetBackup backup policies. Policies define which clients, schedules, and backup selections are used to perform backups. Results can be filtered by policy name and type.

info.name: Veritas Netbackup Create a Backup Policy

items.docs: Creates a new NetBackup backup policy with the specified configuration including policy type, attributes, clients, schedules, and backup selections. The policy name must be unique within the NetBackup domain.

info.name: Veritas Netbackup Get a Backup Policy

params.name: policyName
params.description: The name of the policy to retrieve

items.docs: Retrieves the complete configuration of a specific backup policy including its attributes, client list, schedules, and backup selections.

info.name: Veritas Netbackup Update a Backup Policy

params.name: policyName
params.description: The name of the policy to update

items.docs: Updates the configuration of an existing backup policy. The entire policy configuration must be provided in the request body. Use this to modify policy attributes, schedules, clients, or backup selections.

info.name: Veritas Netbackup Delete a Backup Policy

params.name: policyName
params.description: The name of the policy to delete

items.docs: Deletes an existing backup policy from the NetBackup configuration. Any scheduled backups associated with this policy will no longer run. Existing backup images created by this policy are not affected.

info.name: Veritas Netbackup List Clients in a Policy

items.docs: Returns the list of clients associated with a specific backup policy. Clients are the machines whose data is backed up according to the policy configuration.

info.name: Veritas Netbackup Update Clients in a Policy

items.docs: Replaces the client list for a specific backup policy with the provided set of clients.

info.name: Veritas Netbackup List Schedules in a Policy

items.docs: Returns all schedules configured for a specific backup policy. Schedules define when and how frequently backups are performed.

info.name: Veritas Netbackup Get a Specific Policy Schedule

items.docs: Retrieves the configuration of a specific schedule within a backup policy including its type, frequency, retention level, and storage unit settings.

info.name: Veritas Netbackup Create or Update a Policy Schedule

params.name: scheduleName
params.description: The name of the schedule to create or update

items.docs: Creates or updates a schedule within a backup policy. If the schedule already exists it is replaced with the provided configuration.

info.name: Veritas Netbackup Delete a Policy Schedule

params.name: scheduleName
params.description: The name of the schedule to delete

items.docs: Removes a schedule from a backup policy. Existing backups created by this schedule are not affected.
